dlentry.dt: Can I use the platform to maintain healthy habits even without a diagnosed condition?
dlentry.dd: Yes. Tap Only Explore during account setup to access health tips and tools.

dlentry.dt: Does anyone other than my doctor or caregiver have access to my health data?
dlentry.dd: No. Not even Welth can access your personal health data.

dlentry.dt: Can I cancel a mistaken medication order?
dlentry.dd: Yes. Go to Pharmacy Shop > Cancel Order.
Yes. Go to Pharmacy Shop > Return Order.

p.ph: Alternatively, open your confirmation email and tap Cancel Order or Return Order directly.
